summary_1line: A Brahmana allegorically describes the spiritual ‘forest of Brahman’ and teaches detachment, self‑restraint, and realization of the self beyond sensory experience.

image_candidates.scene_text: A serene Brahmana describes a vast mystical forest where seven luminous trees bear multicolored fruits while sages gather beneath them.
In the symbolic forest, a radiant tree of Intelligence casts the cool shade of Tranquillity while the sunlike Kshetrajna shines above.
Seven glowing female figures with faces turned downward hover in the mystical forest, drawing the tastes of all creatures into themselves.
